# File `pre-push`

Verify that every commit newly introduced by a push is signed.

Git streams four-field ref updates on standard input and passes the remote as an argument. The Python checker owns revision-set construction and raw commit inspection; this hook only adapts Git's invocation to that shared policy.

[Source](../../hooks/pre-push)
